section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section focuses on the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran, specifically among a university population of men and women. It highlights the one-factor structure of the Persian BAS-2, its internal consistency, and convergent validity through correlations with self-esteem and life satisfaction. The section also notes the negative association between BAS-2 and BMI in women, and a positive association in men, contrasting with previous research. Limitations include the university-based sample, self-reported BMI, and lack of ethnicity data.
